title: Boomerang
desc: Three men arrive at an apartment in search of someone. However, complications arise when they are trapped there by a woman, who seeks revenge.

title: Mr. Butler
desc: Gopalakrishnan, a chef, escapes from his village to a city when his marriage gets ruined. Later, he falls in love with Radhika, but his happiness is short-lived as his past returns to haunt him.

title: Gatta Kusthi
desc: Veera has a preconceived set of criteria for what he wants in a bride. However, he ends up unexpectedly marrying a woman who is the complete opposite of his expectations.

title: Devil
desc: Set in pre-independence India, a covert intelligence operative gets tangled in love, deception and betrayal, while investigating the mysterious murder of a zamindar's daughter.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Poojai
desc: A temple priest gives evidence in court about a murder that he has witnessed. Unfortunately for him, he bears witness against an influential landlord.
